name: wealth-shown-to-scale
description: Extreme wealth, shown to scale: a bilingual (EN/DE) static site with a 1-pixel-per-1,000 side-scroll, a rice visualisation, a spend simulator, a Germany chapter, a tax chapter and steel-manned objections. Data is refreshed monthly by a GitHub Actions pipeline.

scripts.build: npm run check:i18n && npm run validate-data && vite build && node --import tsx scripts/build-pages.ts
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run check:i18n && npm run validate-data && vitest run
